question.prompt: Solve the inequality \(3x-2\le x+4\) and express its solution set. (Only write the solution set, for example, \(x\ge1\).)

solutions.explanation: Transposing terms gives \(2x\le6\). Dividing both sides by 2 gives \(x\le3\). On the number line, draw a filled point at 3 and a ray extending to the left.
solutions.title: Isolate the variable
